title: Random name picker wheel
when: The user wants a spinning wheel or picker that chooses a random name or option from a list, for raffles, classrooms or decisions.
prompt:
Goal: A fair pick decided before the spin, an animation that lands exactly on it and a clear announcement.
Steps:
1. Labeled textarea, one name per line; trim and drop blank lines.
2. Wheel on canvas or SVG with equal slices, text along each slice and distinct colors with labels.
3. Choose the winner first with crypto.getRandomValues, then compute the final angle so the pointer lands inside that slice; animate 4 s ease out with requestAnimationFrame.
4. logic.mjs: parseNames, pickIndex(n, randomInt), targetAngle(i, n, turns, jitter) and indexAtAngle(angle, n), which must agree.
5. Announce "Winner: Ana" in aria-live; option to remove the winner for the next spin.
6. With prefers-reduced-motion (matchMedia), skip the spin and show the result; save the list in localStorage guarded.
7. test.mjs: targetAngle and indexAtAngle agree for every index, parsing.
Quality bar:
- Winner readable at a distance.
- Long names truncated with full text in the result.
- Works with 2 to 100 entries.
Pitfalls:
- Deciding the winner from where a random spin stops.
- Pointer landing on a slice border.
- Spin button not disabled during a spin.
Verify:
- [ ] Textarea labeled.
- [ ] Result live.
- [ ] Angles tested.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, app.js (wheel and animation), logic.mjs (pick and angles), test.mjs.

examples.input: roleta para sortear nomes da turma
examples.output: textarea of 30 names, Spin, "Winner: Joao", remove winner option
